Every tag's keywords must appear in the routing prose of each file declared for it; every via hop must be a real link; every case must reach its must_load files. No BUILD step names any rules file: BUILD step 1 says to read 'the matching rules files from the index below', so every route here is an index row (declared so it is a visible decision). Cases from real incidents: a gate's known-bad (2026-08-20, then rules/05 section 5.6, now rules/09 section 2), reached only by 09's row, since 05 does not link 09 and BUILD step 3 ('every gate ... fails closed') names no file; the declared-but-not-reached sweep (2026-07-30, rules/10); a hook that passes locally and fails in CI (the skill description's trigger, rules/11 section 5).
